# Results (generated by `python -m churn.train`)

- Customers: 7,043 (5,634 train, 1,409 test); churn rate 26.5%
- Chosen model: **XGBoost (tuned)** (highest cross-validated ROC-AUC), MLflow run `578d58bb9177409a97137296f0785e81`
- Tuned parameters: {'colsample_bytree': 0.6943, 'learning_rate': 0.0209, 'max_depth': 2, 'min_child_weight': 8, 'n_estimators': 366, 'reg_lambda': 0.443, 'subsample': 0.8171}

## Retention campaign on the test set

Assumptions: offer costs 60 per customer, keeps 30% of would-be churners, each saved customer is worth 12 months of their bill.

| policy | customers_targeted | share_targeted | churners_caught | precision | net_value |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nobody (do nothing) | 0 | 0.0% | 0.0% | – | 0 |
| Everyone | 1409 | 100.0% | 100.0% | 26.5% | 13,434 |
| All month-to-month contracts | 773 | 54.9% | 88.0% | 42.6% | 37,566 |
| Model: top 20% by churn risk | 282 | 20.0% | 50.3% | 66.7% | 35,380 |
| Model: expected value > 0 | 576 | 40.9% | 75.1% | 48.8% | 46,799 |

Model rule minus month-to-month rule: 9,233 (+25%), bootstrap 95% CI 6,054 to 12,857; positive in 100% of resamples
